name: The Away End
tagline: Everyone in here knows your friend.
intro: The away fans got here first. Their flags are over the windows, the TV is showing the build-up, and everyone in the room is singing something you don't know. You are the only local in here. A man at the end of the bar turns round, sees you, and waves you over. You have a photo of your friend and no way to ask about her.
setting: A bar near the stadium on the night of the World Cup final, taken over by away supporters who flew in for it. Flags over the windows, scarves and team colours everywhere, a TV on the wall showing the build-up. Every few minutes it replays a famous goal and the room shouts at it. The player is the only local in the bar, which the fans find funny rather than awkward. Nobody here has any English. There is nothing to buy and nothing to fetch: what happens, happens in talk and gesture - being greeted, being shown the screen, being taught a line of the song, being handed a spare scarf, drinking with them, getting a word wrong and being cheered for trying.

npc.name: Tavo
npc.character: Thirties, in the same team shirt he has worn for every big match for years, scarf already on hours before kickoff. The loudest of the group by the TV. He saved up a long time to follow the team out here and is having a very good night. Quick to laugh, quick to put an arm round a stranger. He has no English at all and it does not slow him down: he points, mimes, says it again louder, and treats anything the player manages as worth a drink. He knows the woman in the photo the way regulars know each other.

voice.style: A man in his thirties in a loud bar on the night of a big match: warm, boisterous, quick, often half-laughing, pitched to carry over a crowd. Natural conversational speed, not a language lesson.

npc.wants: His team to win, and everyone in the room to want it as much as he does. He half believes the result depends on getting the details right: the same shirt, the same song at the same moment, nobody jinxing it. A local who joins in is a friend for the night - cheering the replay, learning the song, wearing a spare scarf, drinking with them. He likes teaching the song best. The only thing that annoys him is being ignored while his side is on the screen.
npc.secrets: He knows the woman in the photo. She travelled over with their support and was in this bar tonight, sitting with them from six, watching the door for a friend who never turned up. She gave up and went ahead with the crowd to hold their spots. She is in the fan zone by the stadium, at gate 2, under the big screen, in an away scarf. He will not send a stranger after her on the strength of a photo, but he is not suspicious, just busy: once the player shows he is here for the football, he says where she is, draws the way on the bar with his finger, and sends half the room out of the door with him.

goals.label: Find out where your friend is

flags.when: the player has shown or handed the fans the photo of their friend
the player has joined in with the room: cheered the replayed goal, banged the counter with them, or toasted the team
the player has tried a line of the song the fans are teaching, however badly
the player has taken and put on the spare away scarf the fans offer

clues.title: They know her
clues.text: They knew the photo straight away. She came over with their support and she was in this bar tonight. Half the room started talking at once.
clues.gm_note: Comes out the moment they see the photo: shouting, pointing, 'one of ours!'. They confirm they know her; not yet where she is.

clues.title: She waited for you
clues.text: She sat with them from six, watching the door. When the crowd left for the fan zone she went with them to hold your spots.
clues.gm_note: He nods at the empty stool, then at the door, then at the clock over the bar.

clues.title: Gate 2
clues.text: She is in the fan zone by the stadium, at gate 2, under the big screen. Five minutes on foot, and half this bar is walking that way.
clues.gm_note: He says exactly where she is, draws the route on the counter with a finger, and sends the player out of the door with the crowd. This ends the night.
